name: Retrieval Result Normalizer
description: Normalize retrieval scores onto one comparable scale by min-max, rank or z-score, handling score direction and the constant-score case that naive min-max turns into NaN.
install: No additional packages required. Copy with: ragkit add <id>
missing_dependency_message: retrieval-result-normalizer declares no optional dependencies. If an import fails, restore the project environment with: uv sync
